caption: The drawing depicts a single, central object, which is a lidded pitcher or tankard with a rounded body that curves inward at the neck and then flares outward toward the opening. The object has a single, large, curved handle attached at the top edge near the lid and at the side of the body near its widest point. The top features a domed lid with a small, pointed finial. The pitcher stands on a broad, circular base that narrows as it rises to meet the body. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray on an off-white background, with shading giving the pitcher a metallic or reflective appearance. The main object is centered within a square border. In the bottom right corner, there is a smaller, inset line drawing of the same pitcher, shown in profile, along with some measurement markings or notes. The name "Irving D. Gerin" is written near the lower edge of the square border, above the bottom-right inset drawing.
title: Pewter Pitcher
